CacheControl.description: Private current or immutable authenticated cache policy; errors are no-store.

ETag.description: Strong validator for the exact authenticated representation.

ToolingManagementCredential.description: Project/environment-bound management credential with `schema.read`. It cannot enumerate projects or environments.

ToolingOAuth.description: Official CLI OAuth device access token. It must target the Tooling resource and include `tooling:read`.

info.description: Originless, bearer-only project discovery and immutable published-schema retrieval for the official CLI and approved CI integrations.
